Fixes the connection dropping and having to reconnect (with a new MFA prompt) while the background SSH connection was in use.

The background process that holds the SSH connection exited whenever a local tunnel connection was reset (`read ECONNRESET`), which happens when an editor window closes or reloads a connection abruptly. That took every window's connection down with it. A reset now closes only that one tunnel connection.

Upgrading from 1.1.0 needs no setting changes. Close the editor, then install the new `.vsix` or re-run the install script.

### Fixed
- the background SSH connection no longer shuts down with `Uncaught exception: read ECONNRESET` when a local tunnel connection is reset; only that connection is closed
- a tunnel connection whose SSH channel could not be opened is now closed instead of left hanging
